ihagrrep7cnr3570-001.notes: This is a composite file from the ministry. It holds: (1) Hoym's letter of 30 July 1796 from Breslau to Minister von der Reck, asking him to have the charters made out in the Lehns Canzley and to always add the clause "cum appertinentia"; (2) a copy of Hoym's report of 14 July to the King, proposing the confiscated Prusimski estates for Hohenlohe and other estates for six officers; (3) a copy of the cabinet order of 23 July approving this; (4) the covering letter of 9 August to Hoym; (5) the report to the King; (6) the draft charter for the Prince; (7) Hoym's letter of 20 August to Goldbeck returning the co-signed charters.

claims.statement: Hoym schlägt vor, dem Fürsten von Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen die Prusimski konfiszierten Güter Kamionna, Kolno, Trąbczyn, Szetlewek, Nowawies, Lazy, Alt- und Neu-Laske, Osiny, Hauland Trąbczyński und Brzyce zu verleihen
Die Kabinettsordre genehmigt dies sowie Güter für Sanitz, Blücher, Dolffs, Pontanus, Holtzendorff und Larisch
Entwurf der Schenkungsurkunde für den Fürsten
Hoym wünscht die Klausel cum appertinentia
